mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for three consecutive months, it indicates a weak labor market that may prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain low interest rates, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5% for three months, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In expansionary regimes with rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
